Card keywords — a word (like "Heavy") that automatically adds its own description text before or after a card's description wherever it's used. Define them here; pick which cards use one from that card's own editor.
Card frame art — 598×844px. The dashed box shows where the card's own portrait art will show through (498×380px). Any type left unset falls back to "All Cards."

03 Enchantments & Afflictions

Enchantments persist on a card until explicitly removed (with a Remove Enchantment action) — they don't wear off on their own. Afflictions are per-combat — unlike Enchantments, they only last for the current combat.

06 Pets

0 pets
A companion creature fighting alongside you — like Osty. Not yet compiled into your mod's code. Every STS2 character reflected so far has ONE fixed companion (Player.Osty) that already exists on the base game's Player type; no confirmed way for a mod to define an ADDITIONAL or REPLACEMENT pet/companion of its own has been found — unlike Orbs below, there isn't even a real namespace/folder convention pointing at one existing anywhere. What you enter here is saved with your character and exported as a design doc (Pets/README.md in the compiled mod) so it's ready if a real mechanism is ever confirmed — it just doesn't generate any gameplay code yet.

07 Orbs

0 orbs
A Defect-style gameplay Orb (Frost/Lightning/Dark, etc.) — channeled into a slot, with a passive effect each turn and a bigger effect when evoked. Passive/Evoke value below compile into a real orb class now — confirmed against BaseLib.Abstracts.CustomOrbModel's exact shape using a real working example (TheBurdenedNewCharacter.Orbs.MoonOrb). What's still just a design note: the passive/evoke effect text (what the orb actually does) and Focus-scaling — Forge doesn't have an effect editor for orb behavior yet, so those stay freeform and export to Orbs/README.md alongside the real .cs file. (Note: this is a different concept from the character's energy orb art in the Art section below — that's the visual HP/energy orb graphic, not a gameplay Orb.)

08 Chronicles

0 chronicles
A Chronicle is a named group of Epochs shown together on your character's timeline. Compiles to a real MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Timeline.StoryModel — each Epoch inside it compiles to a real EpochModel subclass, with at least one of your own cards locked behind it and a real, enforced unlock requirement (checked against real save-file stats, e.g. wins/losses/floors climbed — not just descriptive text) that decides when the epoch — and the cards behind it — actually unlocks for the player.
